scope: All 323 tracked files at baseline ac40c87ba47a4dc8d552e57d5cdfe7bd100a1bde in the active audit checkout. 127 prior reviews were reused only after exact-content verification; changed files were re-reviewed. Lock files received dependency/integrity checks, SVGs XML/reference/checksum checks, and PNGs visual inspection. This records file coverage, not a guarantee that every defect has been found.

findings.problem: A throwing localStorage getter/read/write aborts consent initialization or ignores a choice.
findings.resolution: Guard optional persistence; apply consent and dismiss the card even without storage.
findings.verification: Four source-script Node regression tests pass; original source fails three. Ten isolated Chromium component scenarios (1440x900 and 390x844) pass, with synthetic GA network responses, no page/console errors or horizontal overflow.

findings.problem: Pages marks the unversioned og-amsonia.svg immutable for one year, retaining old content across releases.
findings.resolution: Revalidate the stable filename; retain immutable hashed/versioned assets.
findings.verification: Cloudflare Pages deployment contract test passes.

findings.problem: Eight bearer-protected operations omit the actual 401 response.
findings.resolution: Add Unauthorized responses and capture eight real unauthenticated handler exchanges in the PostgreSQL contract fixture.
findings.verification: Parsed all 46 operations and 268 local references; exact semantic comparison confirms only eight 401 additions. PostgreSQL/HTTP contract acceptance runs in current-commit GitHub CI.

findings.problem: Ignored decisions/dead setup obscure permission cases; missing-subject test repeats missing-tenant; a concurrent-cycle test is entirely sequential; UI policy fixtures use nonexistent reason codes; a stale comment contradicts last-administrator protection.
findings.resolution: Assert complete decisions, cover both principal fields and row orders, add genuinely simultaneous reciprocal grants and persisted-graph assertions, and use current reason codes/comments.
findings.verification: Go formatting passes; unit, PostgreSQL and frontend suites run in current-commit GitHub CI.

findings.problem: Remaining setup instructions advertise Go 1.26.10 below go.mod minimum 1.26.11.
findings.resolution: Align active setup instructions with the required toolchain; keep explicitly historical artwork evidence dated.

findings.problem: The Compose organization-recovery command omits the generated env file used by make demo; required interpolation fails in a fresh shell.
findings.resolution: Use the same env file and Compose files as the local launcher.

findings.problem: Current-looking documentation describes a stopped AWS origin as active, retired Platform pages as current, and all public assets as immutable.
findings.resolution: Point releases to the existing Pages runbook, align live route/cache documentation with shipped configuration, and label historical artwork validation.

findings.problem: Current-commit npm audit rejects Astro 7.3.6 after November 9 disclosures GHSA-mh32-jxcr-mh9f and GHSA-r3h5-4585-7x3w. Patched Astro requires a newer Node baseline.
findings.resolution: Pin Astro 7.4.12 and regenerate only the site lockfile; align Node 22.23.4 in build images, existing workflows, engines and current development documentation. No local dependency installation/build or audit exception.
findings.verification: Official advisory/release metadata and Node release verified. Updated lockfile audit reports zero vulnerabilities; full compatibility checks run on the new PR head.

validation.local: gofmt, diff whitespace, source-script Node tests, Pages contract test, dependency/provenance integrity, SVG checksums and PNG inspection; no dependency installation or full local build/test suite. Site lock-only npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities; manifest/lock engines and dependency metadata match.
validation.browser: Exact consent markup/script and current CSS in a routed component fixture; synthetic GA responses prevent external tracking. All created contexts closed in finally. This is component verification, not a full Astro-site browser acceptance.
validation.ci: Required full checks run on the resulting PR head; links and exact commit are recorded in the PR and task delivery.
validation.iteration: Initial head 138453a passed Go, web, PostgreSQL/API contract, deployment-contract and archive/browser checks. Site failed on newly disclosed Astro advisories; these are fixed in the follow-up. CodeQL identified a case-sensitive HTML extraction expression in the new test; extraction now matches case-insensitively. Final acceptance must use the resulting head, not the initial green subsets.
